annotations.title: Is private money flowing into this industry or away from it?

description: Use when the user asks where private capital is going, how crowded an industry is with funded competitors, or whether fund-raising is picking up: "are biotech private raises up this year?", "who raised money in restaurants lately?". Returns, quarter by quarter, Form D notices naming the industry group as a share of all Form D notices, whether that share is rising or falling, and the latest issuers with their stated offering amounts and amounts sold, each linked. Notices, not completed raises. Refuses before you are charged if its controls fail. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For public-company merger activity in a sector, use run_deal_activity.
